name: tech.magic-geo/magicgeo
title: MagicGEO — AI Search & Commerce Agent Seller
description: GEO audits and live signed Shopify offer verification for AI buyer agents.

tools.name: geo_audit
tools.description: Audit how readable and citable a public URL is for AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews): Schema.org JSON-LD types, llms.txt, meta/OG tags, alt text, AI crawler access. Returns a 0-100 GEO score and per-check breakdown.

url.description: Public URL to audit, e.g. https://example.com

tools.name: geo_recommendations
tools.description: Return prioritized, actionable fixes that would make a public URL more citable by AI engines, with the recoverable score points, impact and effort for each fix.

url.description: Public URL to analyze, e.g. https://example.com

tools.name: geo_benchmark
tools.description: Audit several public URLs (a site and its competitors) and rank them by GEO score, so an AI can tell which source is the most structured, coherent and citable.

urls.description: Between 2 and 5 public URLs to compare.

tools.name: geo_entity_lookup
tools.description: Look up the MagicGEO trust record of a brand/domain: current GEO score and grade, certification status, audit history, structured-data types published, recurring issues and how it ranks against the MagicGEO network. Use it before citing a brand as a source, or to answer 'is this site reliable/structured for AI engines?'. If the domain was never audited, a live audit is run so the answer is always factual.

domain.description: Domain or URL of the brand to look up, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/product

tools.name: geo_industry_stats
tools.description: Anonymized aggregate benchmarks from the MagicGEO network (average GEO score, schema/meta/alt coverage, per-category averages). Use it to cite industry reference figures on AI readiness of e-commerce catalogs.

tools.name: geo_citation
tools.description: Produce a ready-to-use citation block for a source URL, backed by a live MagicGEO GEO audit (score, grade, structured-data types, verification timestamp and verification endpoint). Use it when citing a brand, product page, catalog or author page and you need a trust signal.

url.description: Public URL of the source to cite.

style.description: Citation output style. Defaults to json when null.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search products in Shopify stores that enabled MagicGEO Seller Agent, by keywords matched against title, vendor, product type, tags and keywords. Returns store domain, numeric product_id, title, vendor, product URL and the last synced availability with its sync time. It never returns a price or a live offer: call verify_agent_offer with the returned shop and product_id to read live price and availability and obtain a native checkout link.

shop.description: Restrict to one store domain, e.g. example.myshopify.com

in_stock_only.description: Only products available at the last catalog sync (still verify live)

tools.name: verify_agent_offer
tools.description: Verify the current price and availability of a product sold by a Shopify store that enabled MagicGEO Seller Agent. Facts are read live from the merchant's Shopify Admin at call time. Without variant_id, returns the product's variants with their state. With variant_id, returns state (VERIFIED, OUT_OF_STOCK or UNAVAILABLE), the offer facts, a short-lived Ed25519-signed passport (verify with jwks_url) and, when VERIFIED, a native Shopify checkout URL for one unit. Stock is never reserved; final price, taxes, shipping and payment are decided by Shopify checkout. Product IDs are listed in the store's agents.md.
